checks.model: passed — twelve targeted tests; per-volume solubility basis, interpolation, kelvin sensitivity, conservation, equal/exchanged temperatures, reference-model agreement, independent RK4 and Simpson quadrature, probe clearance, annular bath and stored-record validation
checks.twoD: passed — matched top-view cells, calibrated thermometers, historical mass traces and single-grain reference views; both target crossings recorded and no future trace points; five viewport sizes with no text overlap or clipping
checks.threeD: passed — temperature-held bath jackets, shared glass floor, rim-clamped thermometers, fitted instrument labels, supported shrinking grains, isolated reference wireframes and padded cameras; reset/inspection preserve measurements
checks.responsive: passed — both viewers at 320×740, 390×844, 820×1180, 1280×960 and 1920×1080; whole/inspection 3D and normal 3D layouts, dark normal 2D laptop and mobile 2D inspection; compact visible playback labels, no page overflow and both canvases contained in stage
checks.practicalRecord: passed — sixteen GUI trials including initial/final, both target transitions, equal 10/10 and 20/20 controls, exchanged settings and 5/60 °C limits; report download, sixteen formula substitutions, notes and reload persistence
checks.playback: passed — full 110-second guide and 180-model-second manual trial completed live; pause/resume, replay, seek, record locks and Escape tested; temperature/time assumptions explicitly labelled Independent 2D-only 110-second guide completed; live SVG checks verified both grain widths shrink and the hotter sample shrinks faster.
checks.cleanLoad: passed — final fresh-load interactions retained sixteen rows and produced no new warnings/errors

developmentNote: Improved thermometer texture aspect/fit, separated portrait scale labels from data, kept tiny residues distinct from zero, and shortened visible manual controls while preserving descriptive accessible labels. Expanded target-time reporting with actual kelvin/coefficient/capacity/side/integral substitutions and independently checked quadrature. Normal-layout captures were scrolled back to the viewer after editing notes; observation timeouts were never used to restart the server.
reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser-viewport review only, not independent expert, official-board, empirical rate/RPM or physical-device certification. The temperature sensitivity is chosen, baths/mixing are ideal, water mass/density and solid density are references, and volume/heat-flow/convection are excluded. Standard OrbitControls is bound; pointer dragging was not recorded.
